notes.title: Move Python Lines DLC is out!
notes.notes: [p]Challenge your Python skills in 80 new levels![/p]

notes.title: Some small features implemented
notes.notes:
Feature list:
[list]
[*] [b]Level Progress Saving[/b]: Your progress is now saved — you no longer have to restart levels when revisiting.
[*] [b]Resizable Sub-windows[/b]: Adjust the size of each section (Code, Output, Goal, Input) to your preference.
[*] [b]Clearer Code Block Separators[/b]: Improved visibility of code block dividers and clearer movement restrictions.
[*] [b]Reset Progress Option[/b]: Start fresh anytime by deleting all your progress.
[/list]
